text: it doesnt line up with the walls tho. it should be a wall type
resolution: Fixed the door alignment issue by making one-piece origin prefabs place as their contained catalog piece instead of using generic prefab grid snap. Door Wall, Open Doorway, and residential window wall methods now inherit wall edge snap/size so they line up with normal walls; multi-piece elevator prefabs still use grid-origin composition placement. Added build grammar coverage for the wall-type placement basis and documented the fix in CAPTURE.md.
